change_summary: Preserve attachment evidence, complete durable edits at their Corvio owner, discover typed continuations, bound ambiguous-owner retrieval, and separate one-off deliverables from reusable-Skill admission.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.5 clarifies attachment edit authority and makes typed prior-work handles an observable continuation trigger, while durable current-artifact changes return to their Corvio owner.

server_contract.note: The unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract now presents the same transient-answer, one-off-artifact, and reusable-Skill distinction in server-delivered host guidance.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.5 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.5.

package_setup.note: OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host harness now judges preservation of pre-existing fixture bytes separately from legitimate derived outputs, while the mainline records the attachment-versus-native-target boundary.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers immutable source fixtures with allowed derived outputs plus fresh Codex and Claude attachment-update reruns against the live MCP.
